definitions.explanation: Insurance that covers medical expenses. In Japan, this primarily refers to the public health insurance system that covers all residents, but can also refer to supplementary private medical insurance.

examples.japanese: {医療保険|いりょうほけん}に{加入|かにゅう}する。
{日本|にほん}では{国民|こくみん}{皆|かい}{保険|ほけん}で、{全員|ぜんいん}が{医療保険|いりょうほけん}に{入|はい}っている。
examples.english: In Japan, under the universal insurance system, everyone is covered by medical insurance.

examples.japanese: {民間|みんかん}の{医療保険|いりょうほけん}に{入|はい}っておくと、{入院|にゅういん}{費用|ひよう}の{負担|ふたん}が{軽|かる}くなる。
examples.english: If you take out private medical insurance, the burden of hospitalization costs becomes lighter.

notes:
Japan's public health insurance system ({国民皆保険|こくみんかいほけん}) is one of the most comprehensive in the world, covering all residents. Most people pay 30% of medical costs out of pocket, with insurance covering the rest.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {医療保険|いりょうほけん}に{加入|かにゅう}する: to enroll in health insurance
- {医療保険|いりょうほけん}{制度|せいど}: health insurance system
- {公的|こうてき}{医療保険|いりょうほけん}: public health insurance
- {民間|みんかん}の{医療保険|いりょうほけん}: private medical insurance

JAPAN'S SYSTEM:
- {健康保険|けんこうほけん} ({健保|けんぽ}): employee health insurance (for company workers)
- {国民健康保険|こくみんけんこうほけん} ({国保|こくほ}): national health insurance (for self-employed and others)
- {後期高齢者医療保険|こうきこうれいしゃいりょうほけん}: medical insurance for the elderly (75+)

RELATED WORDS:
- {保険証|ほけんしょう}: insurance card — the card you present at hospitals
- {自己負担|じこふたん}: out-of-pocket expense
- {生命保険|せいめいほけん}: life insurance — different from medical insurance
